title: defenseclaw-gateway --version-json
description: The one line `defenseclaw-gateway --version-json` prints, with exit code 0, also on a managed device (machineVersionReport, internal/cli/root.go). management_contract is the version of the management agent contract (management-agent.md) that the build implements; a build without the member predates the contract, and the agent uses the fallbacks in management-agent.md section 3. There is no features list: a build that reports management_contract 1 implements all of contract 1.

name.description: Constant, also when the binary runs as defenseclaw or defenseclaw.exe.

management_contract.description: The management agent contract version (management-agent.md). A breaking change to a verb, flag, schema or exit code of the contract bumps it; new optional members do not.

secret_set_bundle.description: Optional, from 1.0.4: `enterprise secret set` takes --bundle (management-agent.md section 4.7). A build without the member refuses the flag; store the credential without it.

identity_refresh.description: Optional, from 1.0.6: `enterprise identity refresh` re-reads directory facts on demand (management-agent.md section 4.10). A build without the member has no such command.
